name: group-sixteen/library-system
description: Library Management System, DB II CAT 2. Composer is used only to run the scripts below; there are no packages.

scripts-descriptions.dev:doctor: Check PHP, MySQL, the database and Apache, and print a fix for anything missing
scripts-descriptions.dev:start: Start Apache and MySQL and print the app link
scripts-descriptions.dev:seed: Create library_db and load the sample data (erases local data)
scripts-descriptions.code:check: Run the code checks GitHub runs
scripts-descriptions.code:check:full: Code checks plus the database import and app smoke test
scripts-descriptions.hooks:install: Run the code checks before every git push
